init_CLAP_model: create a CLAP model instance with an optional checkpoint path and device
call_CLAP_similarity: compute CLAP similarity scores between audio waveforms and text descriptions
encode_audio_to_wav: encode torch audio tensors into WAV files using AudioEncoder for CLAP processing
compute_audio_text_embeddings: compute audio and text embeddings using the CLAP model for similarity comparison
review_CLAP_call_method: review the CLAP __call__ method that calculates audio-text similarity via matrix multiplication
